decision: The run is NOT accepted for performance interpretation because RABIT C=16/32/64 in all three trials compiled Triton kernels during the measured phase. Its throughput / latency values are not interpreted, not published, and not pooled with any rerun. C<=8 points are NOT salvaged. The whole run is diagnostic evidence for the warmup deficiency only.
archival_note: Every other file in this directory is the byte-exact output of the run (moved unchanged from results/mlsys2027/concurrency_scaling/L2048/; SHA-256 verified before and after the move). Paths recorded inside manifest.json refer to the original location. This file is the only one added after the run.

execution_facts.target_overlapping_inflight_concurrency: observed max == C with non-zero all-C overlap at all 36 points
execution_facts.selector_qb_exact: 36/36 (RABIT shared_decode / QB32 requested == effective; BF16 no selector; profiling off)

diagnosis.mechanism: The two pre-registered warmup requests contain only 4096 prompt tokens and cannot exercise concurrency-induced chunked prefill. At C>=16, C*2048 > max_num_batched_tokens=16384, so prompts are chunked and later chunks take the RABIT Stage3C (shared_decode) path. The Stage3C marker appeared at every RABIT C>=16 point and at no C<=8 point.
diagnosis.remedy: Point-matched compile-conditioning phase (pre-registered amendment, committed before the rerun).
